text:
Ari: quick flag ":eyes:" — p99 on /v1/generate-us jumped ~160ms after we flipped the routing fallback window. p50/p95 unchanged. https://console.redwood.ai/d/latency-us
Sam: saw it. which flip? we had the fallback policy change at 03:22 UTC to favor cheaper variants during quota pressure
Ari: right — fallback weight bumped 0.12 -> 0.42 at 03:22 by autoscaler policy. traces point to cheap-quant being overrepresented in the tail
Nora: checked rollups: p99 is ↑ but sample_count for the p99 calc is small (~260). p95 sample_count still ~10k. so could be real tail + low-n noise
Sam: cheap-quant has median ok but much heavier tail on kvcache_miss and long sequences. combined with low sample p99 is spiky
Ari: router log snippet around change:
```
[03:22:04] route_update svc=gen-us fallback=0.42
[03:22:05] model_select id=x7 model=cheap-quant seq_len=812
[03:22:06] kvcache_miss id=x7 prefix=session_
```
Nora: two-pronged plan:
- rollback fallback to 0.12 (Ari)
- surface sample_count badge and a low-sample-warning next to p99 in the console (Sam)
- add a per-variant percentile table under endpoint breakdown so model tails are explicit (Nora)
Sam: UX suggestion: show a tiny converging CI band on p99 when sample_count < 1000 and a yellow badge "p99 low-confidence" with hover: "percentile unstable — low sample count or skewed shards"
Ari: ops-bot: please rollback route gen-us fallback -> 0.12 (requested by Ari)
metrics-bot: deploy-bot: Received rollback request from Ari. Rolling route gen-us fallback -> 0.12
Nora: backend ask: when merging tdigest shards include per-shard sample_count and origin tag (route/fallback-rate) so front-end can compute a weighted confidence or fall back to raw-samples for small-n windows
Sam: also add a provenance strip on charts that lists recent routing/quota/aggregation changes with timestamps — would make triage faster
Ari: agree. immediate watch window 15m. if p99 doesn't drop we'll capture extended traces and run a KV-priming canary to separate cold-cache vs model decode tail
Nora: long-term: compute approximate bootstrap CI for percentiles from tdigest metadata or maintain tiny raw buffers for the last 5m so p99 for small samples is reproducible
Sam: I'll mock the UI for the badge + CI band + per-variant table and open a PR after rollback validated
Ari: thanks — i'll post a short incident note in #incidents with timeline and link to this thread
Nora: ACK
metrics-bot: noted. rollback in progress. monitoring metrics stream for p99 recovery
Sam: :thumbsup:
